fields.description: Couture by Cavalli is DAMAC’s canal-side residential development beside Safa Park. The collection combines three- to five-bedroom homes and six-bedroom penthouses with Cavalli interiors, terraces and shared leisure spaces.

research.community: Couture by Cavalli · Dubai Water Canal
overview: The branded presentation shows residences with large terraces and pools, alongside shared leisure spaces. Its examples include single-level apartments and larger multi-level homes. Pool provision, outdoor area and internal layout should be checked on the chosen unit’s drawing rather than inferred from a general render.
research.locationNote: The development sits beside Safa Park and the Dubai Water Canal. Property Finder identifies Al Safa 1. An exact registered parcel and route should be confirmed; nearby views do not guarantee a particular apartment’s outlook.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 22 m as a launch reference. This is not a current inventory quotation. A separate dated presentation contains older unit-specific prices; those have not been presented as homes currently available.
research.paymentNote: The displayed 20/40/40 stages are Property Finder’s reference structure. The branded presentation instead prints 24% deposit, ten 4% instalments and 40% completion, totalling 104%. It does not explain the excess; no fee assumption or silent correction has been made. Request the applicable signed schedule.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder labels the project ready with May 2025 delivery; the reviewed presentation states an anticipated completion of Q1 2028. This conflict remains unresolved, so no headline completion date is selected.
